arxiv-1402-1046.title: Spatial and temporal structures of four financial markets in Greater China
arxiv-1402-1046.creator: F. Y. Ouyang, B. Zheng, X. F. Jiang
arxiv-1402-1046.description: Abstract We investigate the spatial and temporal structures of four financial markets in Greater China. In particular, we uncover different characteristics of the four markets by analyzing the sector and subsector structures which are detected through the random matrix theory. Meanwhile, we observe that the Taiwan and Hongkong stock markets show a negative return-volatility correlation, i.e., the so-called leverage effect.

arxiv-2110-00224.title: Censored autoregressive regression models with Student- t t innovations
arxiv-2110-00224.creator: Katherine A. L. Valeriano, Fernanda L. Schumacher, Christian E. Galarza, Larissa A. Matos
arxiv-2110-00224.description: Abstract The Student- t t distribution is widely used in statistical modeling of datasets involving outliers since its longer-than-normal tails provide a robust approach to hand such data. Furthermore, data collected over time may contain censored or missing observations, making it impossible to use standard statistical procedures.

arxiv-2203-09097.title: On the dynamics of grounded shallow ice sheets: Modelling and analysis.
arxiv-2203-09097.creator: Paolo Piersanti, Roger Temam
arxiv-2203-09097.description: Abstract . In this article we formulate a model describing the evolution of thickness of a grounded shallow ice sheet. The thickness of the ice sheet is constrained to be nonnegative. This renders the problem under consideration an obstacle problem.

arxiv-2306-11197.title: Sparse Modular Activation for Efficient Sequence Modeling
arxiv-2306-11197.creator: Liliang Ren, Yang Liu, Shuohang WangYichong Xu, Chenguang Zhu, Chengxiang Zhai
arxiv-2306-11197.description: Abstract Recent hybrid models combining Linear State Space Models (SSMs) with self-attention mechanisms have demonstrated impressive results across a range of sequence modeling tasks. However, current approaches apply attention modules statically and uniformly to all elements in the input sequences, leading to sub-optimal quality-efficiency trade-offs.

arxiv-2311-03792.title: Character-Level Bangla Text-to-IPA Transcription Using Transformer Architecture with Sequence Alignment
arxiv-2311-03792.creator: Jakir Hasan, Shrestha Datta, Ameya Debnath
arxiv-2311-03792.description: Abstract The International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) is indispensable in language learning and understanding, aiding users in accurate pronunciation and comprehension. Additionally, it plays a pivotal role in speech therapy, linguistic research, accurate transliteration, and the development of text-to-speech systems, making it an essential tool across diverse fields.

arxiv-2401-08623.title: Wake-Sleep Consolidated Learning
arxiv-2401-08623.creator: Amelia Sorrenti, Giovanni Bellitto, Federica Proietto Salanitri, Matteo Pennisi, Simone Palazzo, Concetto Spampinato
arxiv-2401-08623.description: Abstract We propose Wake-Sleep Consolidated Learning (WSCL) , a learning strategy leveraging Complementary Learning System theory and the wake-sleep phases of the human brain to improve the performance of deep neural networks for visual classification tasks in continual learning settings. Our method learns continually via the synchronization between distinct wake and sleep phases.

arxiv-2407-20177.title: AutoScale : Scale-Aware Data Mixing for Pre-Training LLMs
arxiv-2407-20177.creator: Feiyang Kang Virginia Tech, Yifan Sun * UIUC, Bingbing WenUniversity of Washington, Si ChenVirginia Tech, Dawn SongUC Berkeley, Rafid MahmoodUniversity of Ottawa & NVIDIA, Ruoxi Jia † Virginia Tech
arxiv-2407-20177.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Feiyang Kang Virginia Tech, Yifan Sun * UIUC, Bingbing WenUniversity of Washington, Si ChenVirginia Tech, Dawn SongUC Berkeley, Rafid MahmoodUniversity of Ottawa & NVIDIA, Ruoxi Jia † Virginia Tech. Domain reweighting is an emerging research area aimed at adjusting the relative weights of different data sources to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of LLM pre-training.

arxiv-2504-00582.creator: Kim Siang Khaw, Siew Yan Hoh, Tianqi Hu, Xingyun Huang, Jun Kai Ng, Yusuke Takeuchi, Min Yang Tan, Jiangtao Wang, Yinghe Wang, Guan Ming Wong, Mengjie Wu, Ning Yan, Yonghao Zeng, Min Chen, Shunxi Gao, Lei Li, Yujin Shi, Jie Tan, Qinghua Wang, Siping Zeng, Shibin Yao, Yufu Zhang, Gongliang Chen, Houw

arxiv-2507-18056.title: Anomalous increasing super reflectance in chiral matter
arxiv-2507-18056.creator: Pedro D. S. Silva a, Alex Q. Costa b, Ronald A. Pereira b, Manoel M. Ferreira Jr. b,c
arxiv-2507-18056.description: Abstract Magnetic and anomalous Hall conductivities induce anomalous transport features and novel optical phenomena in chiral systems. Here, we investigate reflection properties on the surface of a medium ruled by axion electrodynamics, which effectively describes optical aspects of Weyl semimetals.

arxiv-2510-22152.title: A great diversity of spectral shapes in the ionising spectra of z z ∼ \sim 0.6 – 1 galaxies revealed by HST /COS and possible detection of nebular LyC emission
arxiv-2510-22152.creator: Y. I. Izotov, D. Schaerer, G. Worseck, N. G. Guseva, A. Verhamme, C. Simmonds, J. Chisholm
arxiv-2510-22152.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Y. I. Izotov, D. Schaerer, G. Worseck, N. G. Guseva, A. Verhamme, C. Simmonds, J. Chisholm. We present observations of eleven compact star-forming galaxies in the redshift range z z = 0.6145 – 1.0053, with the Cosmic Origins Spectrograph (COS) on board the Hubble Space Telescope ( HST ).

pmc-12457435.title: Effect of physical activity on anthropometric and physiological parameters in preschool and school-aged children: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-12457435.creator: Nina Wang, Qinglei Wang, Mengyan Wang, Mohd Nazri Bin Abdul Rahman
pmc-12457435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEarly childhood is an essential phase characterized by physical, social, and cognitive development. This developmental stage lays the foundation for establishing lifelong health behavior patterns that can resonate into adolescence and adulthood. Despite the growing recognition of the significance of physical activity during crucial developmental periods, the advent of technology-driven modern society has induced a notable preference among children for a sedentary lifestyle.

pmc-12737704.title: Discriminative Cut-Offs, Concurrent Criterion Validity, and Test–Retest Reliability of the Oxford Vaccine Hesitancy Scale
pmc-12737704.creator: Jonathan Kantor, Samantha Vanderslott, Michael Morrison, Robert C. Carlisle
pmc-12737704.description: Background: Validated instruments can be used to quantify vaccine hesitancy, but few provide transportable operational cut-offs or temporal stability metrics. We evaluated the Oxford Vaccine Hesitancy Scale (OVHS) to quantify discrimination for the self-reported historical COVID-19 vaccine refusal, derive and validate a single operational cut-off across populations, and assess the test–retest reliability.

pmc-13212909.title: Compact adaptive spectral imager enabled by MEMS Fabry-Perot filtering chip in longwave infrared
pmc-13212909.creator: Kui Zhou, Xiaodong Wang, Geng Tong, Xingchen Xiao, Jiancun Zhao, Xiaochang Yu, Yiting Yu
pmc-13212909.description: Longwave infrared (LWIR) spectral imaging offers unique capabilities for gas/liquid detection, mineral exploration, environmental monitoring, and military security applications. Conventional LWIR spectral imagers, however, are hampered by reliance on existing dispersion elements, resulting in inflexible operation, limited spectral channels, and excessive bulk, which preclude deployment in intelligent, multi-scenario settings.

pmc-13229958.title: Microglial polarization in retinal neovascularization: Friend or foe?
pmc-13229958.creator: 雯鑫 徐, 俏燕 韦, 顺 周, 澳华 彭, 纯 丁
pmc-13229958.description: Retinal neovascularization (RNV) is the central pathological process leading to blindness in ischemic retinal diseases, such as retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) and proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR). Current anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) therapies are limited by incomplete responses and substantial injection burdens, highlighting the importance of elucidating novel regulatory mechanisms underlying RNV.

pmc-13303236.title: A Bayesian reevaluation of randomized controlled trials in assisted reproductive technology: quantifying evidence strength for null and alternative hypotheses
pmc-13303236.creator: Jiayi Gao, Tian Tian, Kalbinur Kayimu, Yi Yuan, Yongyan Chen, Yu Fu, Rui Chen, Fang Liu, Yunjun Zhang, Yuanyuan Wang

pmc-13486762.title: Large-scale data-driven inverse EM design based on metacircuit-embedded surface
pmc-13486762.creator: Ming Xu, Song Zha, Mingtuan Lin, Hanqing Liu, Jihong Zhang, Yanlin Xu, Huan Jiang, Qiang Cheng, Peiguo Liu
pmc-13486762.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). General-purpose electromagnetic model is central to intelligent electromagnetic applications. However, its development is limited by severe scarcity of training data, arising from the high computational cost of full-wave simulations and reliance on specialized topologies that yield single EM function. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a metacircuit-embedded surface (MCES) framework, consisting of a fixed structural topology and flexible metacircuits that can be realized through lumped components.

pmc-13491740.title: Liposomal multimodal theranostics for bone disorders: from rational responsive delivery and biomimetic strategies to clinical translation
pmc-13491740.creator: Haifu Sun, Yu Chen, Xuequan Zhao, Xixi Han, Yonggang Li, Yuchen Qian, Zhiheng Gao, Huilin Yang, Nanning Lv, Jiaxiang Bai, Youzhi Hong, Yusen Qiao

pmc-13510779.title: AI-Driven Automated Detection of Pleural Plaques on Chest CT Scans in Retired Asbestos-Exposed Workers
pmc-13510779.creator: Yannis Petitpas, Ilyes Benlala, Fabien Baldacci, Gael Dournes, Kellian Jaunas, Bénédicte Clin, Patrick Brochard, Antoine Gislard, Fleur Delva, Aude Lacourt, Christophe Paris, François Laurent, Jean Claude Pairon, Baudouin Denis de Senneville
pmc-13510779.description: Background/Objective: This study aimed to develop and validate an automated framework for detecting pleural plaques (PPs) at the patient level using a single chest CT scan. Methods: A database of chest CT scans with corresponding individual binary annotations for PP presence was first established through expert visual assessment, based on consensus among a board of specialized radiologists.

pmc-13627141.title: Area Deprivation Index as an Additive Marker of Postdischarge Care Vulnerability in Pediatric Acute Hematogenous Osteomyelitis
pmc-13627141.creator: Connor C Park, Keith D Brendes, Nicholas B Williams, Jens Verhey, Cameron Morris, Jessica D Burns
pmc-13627141.description: BackgroundAcute hematogenous osteomyelitis (AHO) in children requires prolonged antibiotic therapy and structured follow-up. However, successful treatment depends not only on medical management but also on consistent adherence to antibiotics and outpatient care. Socioeconomic disadvantage may influence a family's ability to complete treatment and attend follow-up appointments.

pmc-13713134.title: Long working hours and the risk of ischemic cardiac death: A systematic review and a meta-analysis
pmc-13713134.creator: Marwa Boussaid, Mohamed Ali Chaouch, Hiba Limem, Imen Mlouki, Mohamed Amine Mesrati, Sana Mhamdi, Abir Aissaoui
pmc-13713134.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: The relationship between occupational stress, particularly long working hours, and health outcomes such as ischemic cardiac death has garnered increasing attention. Myocardial infarction, a primary cause of sudden cardiac death, is significantly influenced by workplace stress.
